templates.why_chosen: Densest host-device figure here (900+ shapes, double column, star-rated): a CPU issues commands over a Shared Buffer to a color-coded 4x4 heterogeneous CGRA tile mesh (red BrT, gold CoT, gray BaT tiles).
templates.what_to_learn: Color each tile type in a heterogeneous accelerator mesh by function (red, gold, gray) so the reader sees the mix at a glance, and use dashed insets to zoom into one tile's internal datapath; cap the insets at one or two, since three competing zooms in this figure fight the main diagram for attention.
